descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de utilaje pentru automatizări
Your new field of responsibility
 Software developer (f/m/d) as part of the development team of the Westlock Railway Interlocking System
 Responsible for design and development of software components and integrated modules for the Westlock Railway Interlocking System, it’s design tools and test environments
 You will develop technical requirements and interfaces of complex components to ensure the highest quality of development
 You always coordinate closely within the team and with everyone involved in system/software development.
 You will be part of a multi-site team spanning three countries and time zones.
 Some travel will be required between the development sites
 Capable of working within a highly regulated environment ideally with knowledge and prior experience of CENELEC, SIL 2 and SIL4 System requirements.
 You will also support validation and assessments and support overarching processes in complex products and R&D projects.
 Your Required Skills
 You have completed a degree in a relevant STEM subject (Science Technology Engineering and Mathematics)
 You also have 5+ years of professional experience in software design and implementation (preferred within the Siemens Interlocking Systems)
 You also have experience in agile software development (and usage of DevOps techniques if possible)
 You have knowledge of standards and processes (CENELEC, EN50128, EN50129, etc.)
 You are proficient in C/C++ and if possible one or more scripting languages
 Have knowledge and previous experience of Ada, Structured Text, Visual Basic and MFC
 Knowledge of Siemens development platforms (GUIDE)
 Your profile is rounded off with fluent English skills
